title: Joints and penetrations.
officialText: Joints in or between walls and floors, and penetrations of walls and floors shall be sealed utilizing methods and materials approved by the registered design professional. Joints, penetrations and other interruptions shall be sealed in accordance with the manufacturer’s recommendations.
